physicalNotes: Radius 0.24061064 Jupiter radii from Nies et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.534.3744N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.534.3744N/abstract): 17,201.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
